description: This file contains Kotlin source code defining data classes and parsing logic for the configuration of Talk Mode Gateway in an Android application, specifically for voice capabilities. It includes data structures for representing configuration state and functions for parsing JSON objects to populate these structures.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Data class representing the configuration state for Talk Mode Gateway, including main session key, interrupt flag, and silence timeout.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigParser
classes.description: Object containing parsing functions to convert JSON configuration into TalkModeGatewayConfigState instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject representing the configuration and returns a TalkModeGatewayConfigState instance.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout value from the JSON object, applying fallback defaults if necessary.
